item.title: The 20 Most-Played Steam Next Fest Demos Features Troublemaking Students, Farting Hippos
item.description: Steam Next Fest is currently in full swing, and developers big and small have released new demos so players can discover their upcoming games. While the event runs through Oct. 26, Valve has already revealed to Polygon what the 20 most popular demos out of the 8,000+ games featured are. Multiplayer games dominate the list as friendslop continues to pull big numbers on Steam, as do a couple of shopkeeping sims. In descending order, these are the most-played games of Oct. 2026's crowded Steam Next Fest .

item.title: Stephen King's 10 Best Villains of All Time, Ranked
item.description: Stephen King has many novels, novellas, and short stories in his vault, from deeply vivid and memorable epics to narratives that inspired Academy Award-winning movies . One of the hallmarks of his writing is his ability to create truly memorable villains, whether they’re human or creatures from another world.

item.title: 5 Hardest Platformers Ever Made, Ranked by Difficulty
item.description: Platform games have an undeniable innocence. Since the days of Super Mario Bros. , they've embodied the escapist joy that people associate with the medium. It's hard not to be charmed by the colorful aesthetics, creative styles, and beautifully simple gameplay. Sure, plenty of other genres have emerged over the years, but none have captured the easygoing appeal of running and jumping over obstacles. That pure sense of fun makes platformers the ultimate gaming comfort food . On the other hand, not every bite is so sweet.

item.title: Steam Officially Rolls Out A Calendar Feature To Directly Recommend New Games
item.description: The latest Steam update added a new way for it to recommend new or imminently released games to players. This new Personal Calendar feature will likely have an impact on game discoverability going forward.

item.title: Dead by Daylight Is Losing Another Horror Icon
item.description: Just a few days before Halloween, developer Behaviour Interactive had an unfortunate announcement to make regarding Dead by Daylight . In November, the game's Chucky Chapter will be removed from the multiplayer horror game, giving players a few weeks to decide if they want to acquire Chucky content before it's gone.

item.title: One of 2026’s Best-Rated Games Is Basically Mass Effect With Spies
item.description: This week's news that EA was shutting down Mass Effect developer BioWare and canceling the next game in the series was a blow to the industry. It was made all the worse when a leaked trailer for the game, known as Mass Effect: Universe , showed exactly what we would all be missing: Mass Effect meets James Bond . That sure is an enticing pitch, and while BioWare will never be able to deliver on what the trailer teased, that also describes one of this year's best games.

item.title: Xbox's First-Ever COO Is Already Leaving After A Few Months
item.description: Just a couple of months after being instated as Xbox's first-ever Chief Operating Officer, Helen Chiang has left the company. Her departure reinforces just how much of a whirlwind year 2026 has been for Xbox leadership , as the company continually attempts to reinvent itself before the start of the next generation of consoles.

item.title: Aaron Paul Originally Had A Much More Important Role In Clayface
item.description: Clayface hit theaters this weekend, but one actor's role turned out to be smaller than expected. We knew Aaron Paul would be in the DC horror flick prior to its release, but in the final film, he cameos in just one scene. In a recent interview, director James Watkins revealed that Aaron Paul had a bigger role in Clayface that was mostly cut out of the theatrical release.
